yieldproc.reason: The fully specified offset construction yields an operational 0.2% proof stress despite linear machine compliance, and it is appropriately treated as a crosshead-based rather than specimen-strain measurement.

grain_I.reason: The uncorrected method has a demonstrated ~40% systematic bias relative to the true intercept and cannot apply its stated TIFF-metadata calibration to the JPEG-only state.

grain_II.reason: Watershed segmentation of channeling-contrast images with an intensity-dependent h threshold can oversegment contrast variations, and counting annealing-twin boundaries yields boundary spacing rather than a well-defined grain-size intercept.

tension_fmax.reason: Maximum engineering tensile stress computed as peak force divided by the stated initial cross-sectional area is a standard reduction, and restricting the UTS label to completed fracture tests avoids mislabeling interrupted tests.

s10.reason: Force, crosshead displacement, specimen diameter, and gauge length suffice to compute engineering stress at a stated crosshead strain, with loading-branch selection and interpolation explicitly defined.
